summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of NetPulse Network Visibility app. All 25 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing confirmed all major features working: Overview with live stats and top interfaces, Topology map with 13 nodes and animated traffic lines, Devices table with search/filters, Alerts system with 3 active alerts, Dashboards with widgets, Settings form, and NOC Mode with rotating panels. Real SNMP polling from snmpsim agents working correctly with live bandwidth data oscillating as expected.

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about missing DialogTitle for accessibility
design_issues.note: Functional but shows accessibility warnings in console

passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/overview - returns counts (13 total, 12 up, 1 down), bandwidth totals, 12 top interfaces with utilization, recent alerts
Backend: GET /api/devices - returns 13 devices with live state (up, latency_ms, loss_pct, total_in_bps, total_out_bps, iface_count)
Backend: GET /api/devices/core-rtr-01 - returns detailed state with sysinfo and interfaces array with in_bps/out_bps/util values
Backend: GET /api/topology - returns 13 nodes and 12 edges with status values including 'active', 'crit', 'down'
Backend: GET /api/metrics/device/core-rtr-01?minutes=30 - returns non-empty timeseries data
Backend: GET /api/metrics/interface/dist-sw-02?if_name=to-bh-east&minutes=30 - returns non-empty interface metrics
Backend: POST /api/discovery/run - finds edge-rtr-lab on 127.0.0.1:1612 with snmp_ok=true, vendor=mikrotik
Backend: POST /api/discovery/add - successfully adds discovered device
Backend: Device CRUD - POST create, PUT update, PATCH position, DELETE all working
Backend: GET /api/alerts?state=firing - returns 3 alerts including device_down (ap-west-02), iface_down (to-tower-south), high_util (to-bh-east)
Backend: POST /api/alerts/{id}/ack - successfully acknowledges alert
Backend: GET /api/rules - returns 5 rules
Backend: PUT /api/rules/high_util - successfully updates threshold to 90
Backend: GET /api/settings - returns all settings
Backend: PUT /api/settings - successfully updates poll_interval
Backend: POST /api/settings/test-discord - correctly returns 400 when no webhook configured (expected behavior)
Backend: Dashboards CRUD - GET, POST, PUT, DELETE all working
Frontend: Overview page loads with 4 stat tiles (Devices Online: 12, Devices Down: 1, Active Alerts: 2, Aggregate Traffic)
Frontend: Top Interfaces list shows 12 interfaces with utilization bars and bandwidth values
Frontend: Device drawer opens when clicking top interface row
Frontend: Topology page renders 13 device nodes with animated dashed lines showing traffic
Frontend: Topology shows vendor colors (Mikrotik=orange, Ubiquiti=blue, Cambium=green, Mimosa=yellow)
Frontend: Topology shows ap-west-02 as OFFLINE/down in red (correct - device unreachable)
Frontend: Devices page table lists all 13 devices with latency, loss, throughput, ports
Frontend: Devices page has search input and vendor/status filters
Frontend: Devices page has 'Add Device' and 'Discover' buttons
Frontend: Alerts page shows 3 active alerts with severity indicators
Frontend: Alerts page has tabs for Active, History, and Alert Rules
Frontend: Dashboards page renders default 'Operations Overview' dashboard with 4 stat widgets, Top Interfaces widget, Active Alerts widget
Frontend: Dashboards page has Edit button for layout customization
Frontend: Settings page loads with all sections (SNMP & Polling, Discovery, Alert Thresholds, Discord, NOC Mode)
Frontend: NOC Mode renders large status tiles (Online, Down, Active Alerts, Aggregate)
Frontend: NOC Mode has alert ticker at bottom showing scrolling alerts
Frontend: NOC Mode has exit button (X) in top right corner
Frontend: All navigation links work (Overview, Topology Map, Devices, Alerts, Dashboards, NOC Mode, Settings)

success_percentage.integration: 100% (frontend successfully consuming backend APIs with live data)
